Company Description: KSM-66® Ashwagandha is a premium, full-spectrum root extract derived from Withania somnifera, an adaptogenic herb long revered in Ayurvedic medicine for promoting holistic wellness. This potent botanical ingredient is developed using a unique, proprietary extraction process based on “Green Chemistry” principles—free from alcohol or synthetic solvents—ensuring the preservation of the plant's natural composition while delivering the highest potency. With over 70+ gold-standard human clinical trials and 46+ quality certifications, KSM-66 stands as the most extensively studied and awarded Ashwagandha product on the global market. This extraordinary depth of research and validation is what truly sets it apart. It is not just another botanical extract—it is a symbol of credibility, traceability, efficacy, and safety. It's clinically proven to help: (1) Reduce stress and stress-related food cravings * (2) Improve cognitive function and enhance the quality of sleep* (3) Improve endurance, strength and immune function* (4) Enhance sexual performance health in both men & women, and testosterone in men* SRI-81 Shatavari is a premium, clinically validated root extract derived from Asparagus racemosus, a revered adaptogenic herb in Ayurvedic medicine traditionally known as the “Queen of Herbs” for women’s health. Developed after 8 years of extensive research, SRI-81 is designed to deliver a scientifically optimized concentration of shatavari’s key bioactive compounds, ensuring consistent efficacy while preserving the herb’s natural integrity. The ingredient is supported by 18 human clinical studies, making it the most clinically studied shatavari root extract available today. This strong scientific foundation ensures reliability, safety, and performance for advanced nutraceutical and functional wellness formulations. SRI-81 Shatavari supports women’s health and vitality across multiple life stages—from reproductive years to menopause—by helping maintain hormonal harmony and overall physiological balance. It is clinically shown to help: (1) Support hormonal balance and reproductive health in women*(2) Reduce stress and improve mood and sleep quality* (3) Enhance libido and sexual vitality* (4) Boost lactation and support postpartum recovery* (5) Ease menopausal symptoms such as hot flashes and night sweats* *The above statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration.

Company Description: ProDigest is a dynamic pre-clinical CRO at the forefront of in vitro and ex vivo simulation of the gastrointestinal tract and its microbiome, supporting innovation across the (functional) food, feed, and pharmaceutical industries. With nearly two decades of experience, ProDigest brings together best-in-class technology platforms, a wide array of advanced analytical capabilities, and deep scientific expertise to guide product development from early discovery all the way to final stages. The company supports a broad range of applications, including functional foods and ingredients, pre-, pro-, syn- and postbiotics, nutraceuticals, as well as live biotherapeutic products (LBPs), biologicals, APIs, and complete formulations. What truly sets ProDigest apart is its tailored approach. With the widest portfolio of gut models, each project is built around the client’s specific research question—ensuring the most relevant model is selected, rather than applying a one-size-fits-all solution. This enables clients to uncover health benefits early on, gain valuable insights into mechanisms of action and interindividual variability, and confidently de-risk their product development—all within an animal-free research framework. Driven by a passionate team, a strong culture of innovation, and a commitment to customer success, ProDigest delivers flexible, high-quality, and scientifically robust solutions designed to move your product forward.

Company Description: Enabling Differentiated Nutraceutical Solutions With Optimized Ingredient Delivery. At Lubrizol we empower brands to create truly differentiated nutraceutical solutions through our expertise in optimized ingredient delivery. Our advanced microencapsulation technologies elevate the performance, stability, bioavailability, and sensory experience of nutraceutical actives—unlocking new possibilities for formulators and delivering superior outcomes for consumers. Our portfolio includes advanced microencapsulated minerals— Lipofer™ iron, Magshape™ magnesium , Zincnova™ zinc and Lipocal™ calcium —and high‑performance botanicals including Curcushine™ curcumin , Newcaff™ caffeine and Lipophytol™ phytosterols . Company Description: Welcome to the International Pre-, Pro- and Post-, biotics Association! (IPA) The International Pre-, Pro- and Post-, biotics Association (IPA) is a global non-profit organization bringing together through its membership, the biotic sector’s stakeholders including but not limited to academia, scientists, health care professionals, consumers, industry and regulators. The IPA’s mission is to promote the safe and efficacious use of biotics throughout the world. Holding NGO status before Codex Alimentarius, the IPA is also recognized as the unified Global Voice of Probiotics® around the world. Additionally, the IPA will work with government bodies and industry to assist in establishing scientific standards for biotic supplements, biotic pharmaceutical products and functional foods. IPA will educate consumers on the proven health benefits of all biotics for humans by attending trade shows, health tours/walks and other media functions. IPA promises to always put forth timely, unbiased information to every interested party, and share the documented benefits of all biotics to its international forum of members. Be part of the Global Voice of Probiotics® by becoming an IPA member. IPA members are a diverse representation of the international probiotics sector, bringing together over 120 companies spanning 29 countries from industry, healthcare, academia, research, regulation, and more.

Company Description: Within the range of collagen proteins, GELITA supplies collagen peptides with proven body-stimulating capabilities and tailor-made gelatins. Company Description: ICL Food Specialties is a global leader in providing high-quality functional ingredient systems that deliver exceptional texture and stability to food and beverage products. Their diverse ingredients phosphate portfolio delivers buffering, pH adjustment, water binding and shelf-life enhancement across multiple markets, including meat, poultry, seafood, dairy, beverage, bakery, and alternative proteins. To further expand their reach, ICL Food Specialties is focused on the rapidly growing market for alternative proteins and cleaner-label solutions. Their innovative technology enables the production of plant-based meat and dairy substitutes that are welcome alternatives to conventional animal products. Ideal for flexitarians, vegans and health-conscious consumers who wish to reduce meat consumption without compromising taste or texture. ICL’s award-winning ROVITARIS® lines use plant-based proteins to create products that are virtually indistinguishable from traditional meat. These highly versatile solutions provide a wide variety of texture, color and taste applications that can be vegetarian, vegan or allergy free. Whether providing key ingredient solutions, training, formulation assistance or troubleshooting processing issues, ICL’s technical experts are committed to developing on-trend solutions that bring the best products of today and tomorrow to the market.

Company Description: Alvinesa Natural Ingredients is a pioneer in the circular economy, spearheading the advancement in sustainable plant-based ingredients. With three decades of technical expertise, we manufacture ingredients to unsurpassed quality standards at our low carbon footprint, state-of-the-art facility. With a global presence spanning over 30 countries, Alvinesa continues to lead the charge towards a more sustainable future. Company Description: Concordix is the first and only dietary supplement Designed for Your Body. Developed using high-tech Nordic food science, Concordix Supplements utilize our patented emulsion technology to deliver nutrients within billions of oil droplets in a gelatin matrix, mirroring the structure of food for optimal digestion and nutrient absorption. This eliminates the unpleasant side effects typically associated with less digestible supplement formats and has been clinically shown to increase nutrient uptake by 44.9% compared to softgels. Company Description: Goerlich Pharma is a food supplement supplier in Bavaria, Germany . The family-owned company focuses on the development, contract manufacturing and packaging of f ood supplements, food supplements for special medical purposes and feed supplements - in the form of oil mixtures, powders, capsules, tablets and sticks . We look forward to get in contact with you!

Company Description: Cereal Docks is an Italian industrial group founded 40 years ago by the Fanin family, specializing in primary agro-food transformation. It produces ingredients derived from oilseeds (soybean, sunflower, rapeseed) and cereals (corn, legumes, rice), sourced from both conventional and organic agriculture, for applications in the feed, food, pet-food, pharma, and cosmetic sectors. Cereal Docks connects over 18,000 farmers in Italy and tens of thousands worldwide, enhancing agricultural supply chains and promoting sustainable agronomic practices. With 11 processing facilities and a logistics model integrating sea, rail, and road transport, it transforms over 3 million tons of plant-based raw materials into essential ingredients for nutrition and well-being, while respecting the environment, people, and animals. All products are accompanied by robust quality and safety guarantees: over 50,000 process and product checks annually, 28 active certification schemes, and 60 certifications obtained by Group companies, with an ISO 17025-accredited quality control laboratory. Through its business units, Cereal Docks Group provides a wide range of ingredients: Vegetable Oils from Conventional Farming Vegetable Emulsifiers and Functional Blends Organic Vegetable Oils Corn, Rice and Legumes Gluten-free Flours Sunflower HeliaPro Plant-Based Proteins

Company Description: Since 1958 Elchais has produced and supplied dehydrated vegetables, herbs and fruits to large multinationals companies as well as medium and small size companies. The company products are shipped to several countries globally including all EU countries, North America (USA, Canada, Mexico), MEA, and Asia. Elchais operates 2 production sites one in France and the other in Netherlands. All finished products are produced from Non-GMO raw materials and company is Sustainable certified. The available dehydration technologies are air drying, freeze drying and Vacu Puff® a patented puffing process exclusive to Elchais. The process is fully controlled from farm to fork starting with Elchais Agro Department at farms to finished products ready to ship from the production sites. The company, with its broad and deep dehydration technology expertise, produces and offers the widest range of dehydrated products under one umbrella. Further, the company has network of global Elchais Partner Suppliers for supply of other dehydrated products and raw materials which complements the in-house capabilities. Additionally, beyond standard products in the portfolio company provides it is technological knowhow and expertise to create and develop new exclusive bespoke products with customers as required. Customer relationships, Food Security & Quality and technological leadership are the primary cornerstones and foundation of Elchais.

Company Description: Shanxi Guangsheng Medicinal Capsule Co., Ltd. (GS Capsule) was established in 1983 with over forty years of capsule industry expertise in our world class manufacturing facilities. GS Capsules is a premier global empty hard capsule manufacturer producing Gelatin, HPMC, Pullulan, and Enteric Coated capsules. We offer 14 different capsule sizes ranging from 000# to 5, elongated versions, clinical trial applications and a wide range of customized color options. Currently, GS Capsule is the largest empty capsule manufacturer in China with 48+ billion capsule production capacity. In December 2021, Advent International successfully acquired GS Capsule where Advent International is one of the largest and most experienced global private equity firms. Established in 1984, Advent has invested $70 billion in over 405 private equity investments across 42 countries and deeply committed to the GS Capsule organization. GS Capsule manufacturers to stringent GMP management principles. In order to meet the customer demands of different ethnicity and religious culture, we have been validated through NSF international, British BRC and assigned with a DMF registration number by the US FDA. GS Capsule has also obtained ISO9001, ISO14001 and ISO45001, Halal and Kosher certifications to meet our client’s needs. Our diversified customer base includes companies that make dietary supplements, branded, generic and specialty pharmaceuticals; over-the-counter medicines, and biotech products. GS Capsule products are marketed throughout China and exported globally throughout North America, Europe, Asia and other countries abroad. The GS Capsule vision is something we all own. It powers our mission, drives delivery of our strategy and helps make GS Capsule a place where people can thrive.
